name: nGZGraphic4::cDraw2D::UploadRecord
notes: Lane OZ: a record's buffer pixels copied into its cells' textures. Locks the buffer (0x40), asks bits, the native colour type (pixel format 0x18a7f0), stride and bytes per pixel; per cell (atlas region, texture slot 28, surface slot 22/3 format id): the border texels of the first/last column/row are left out of the source copy (rect shrunk, source offset by one) and filled by copying the neighbouring texel afterwards (a second LockRect of the whole region, rows of the lock); with a colour key (word1c non-zero), equal format ids and 2 or 4 bytes per pixel the ARGB face (QI 0x9ac38991, released at once) gives the colour widths, key = buffer converter(r, g, b) masked, pixels equal to the key written 0 (16-bit loop here, 32-bit UploadKeyed32); otherwise the image manipulator's LoadSurfaceFromMemoryRect (slot 5) with the key word's address. Difftest cDraw2D_UploadRecord (tests/gz_draw2d_upload.cpp, 3000 seeded cases): recording fakes of buffer, textures, surfaces (real memory, pitch, counted while locked), pixel formats and manipulator; compared: every call with normalised arguments, the fakes' reference counts and a hash of each surface and of the source. Cases: pools 0-2, 1-4 columns, 0-4 rows, borders on/off per axis, keys set/clear/unused-byte-only, widths 0 colour bits, formats equal/different, 1/2/3/4 bytes per pixel, buffer lock refused. Not reproduced: a record with rows but no columns (the original reads stale locals). Mutants (lane OZ, tools/mutate.py, 54 over both functions: border flags and offsets, rect edges, source offsets, format and key conditions, bytes-per-pixel gate, colour widths and their order, key conversion and mask, 16-bit loop, border copies, source advance, lock arguments and release, the keyed copy and its strides): all 54 killed. Hooked in src/hook/tables/cDraw2D.cpp.

name: nGZGraphic4::cDraw2D::UploadKeyed32
notes: Lane OZ: width x height 32-bit pixels copied into a locked rectangle of a surface, a pixel whose (value & mask) equals the key written as 0. Nothing is locked when width or height is 0. The original's 16-wide unrolled path runs only when a row's source and destination ranges do not overlap and then gives the scalar result; ours is the scalar loop. Difftest cDraw2D_UploadKeyed32 (6000 seeded cases): a surface with real memory and pitch, sources of their own or windows into the surface's own memory (overlap at every offset), widths 0-40 (16 and over most), strides with odd extra bytes, rectangle and arguments independent, masks all/none/partial; compared: the calls, the reference count and the surface memory. Mutants (lane OZ, tools/mutate.py, 54 over both functions: border flags and offsets, rect edges, source offsets, format and key conditions, bytes-per-pixel gate, colour widths and their order, key conversion and mask, 16-bit loop, border copies, source advance, lock arguments and release, the keyed copy and its strides): all 54 killed. Hooked in src/hook/tables/cDraw2D.cpp.

name: nGZGraphic4::cDraw2DBehaviorTraits::RegistryFor (cAbstractBehaviorTypeT<cIDraw2D>::Registry)
notes: Lane OZ: the cDraw2D event registry (a std::map<id, cEventAttribute>): built on first use, then `attribute` stored under `id` when id is not 0 (replacing a record there); returns the same map each call. First use: the shared 0x1464f0 registers ConnectionChanged and AttributeInfosUpdated in the base registry (0x1480d0, ours), the map is a copy of it, and the device event 0xca7ccbbc 'CurrentDeviceEvent' {1, 0x3b6c3e0a, 2, 4} is added. Ours is a std::optional map in cDraw2D.cpp (the original's is the game global 0x10c95e0, touched only by this function and its atexit destructor 0xd8e8a0, which is never registered now); the original's unused 3-byte allocation (stored at 0x10c95f4, read by nothing) is not made. The first-use build cannot run in the harness (the CRT thread-safe statics and atexit are traps), so the test starts the original from the state that build leaves, built by the test from the decoded build (base registry planted with its guards done, 0x1464f0 run for real, copied, the device event read from the image data at 0xfeb6d8): the first-use build is checked against that expectation, the stores differentially. Difftest cDraw2D_Registry (600 sequences of 1-6 calls, ids 0 / planted / base events / device event / new, attributes with random words): after every call the returned map is the same one and every record (key, id, name by content, four words) matches. Mutants (lane OZ, tools/mutate.py, 12): the store condition and its replace-versus-keep, the 0x1464f0 call, the base copy, each field and the key of the device event, a rebuild on every call: all 12 killed. Hooked in src/hook/tables/cDraw2D.cpp; the gz_draw2d test's registry stand-in is a StandIn on RegistryFor. Lane PD: 0x1464f0 is ours now (cAbstractBehaviorType::RegisterBaseEvents); the test stands in for the base registry 0x1485f0 on both sides (tests/gz_registry_fx.h), the planted base staying the one both read.
